8.4.1.14 Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation
[SWS_Nm_91010] Definition of callback function Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirma-
tion
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02574, SRS_ModeMgm_09250
⌈
Service Name
Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation
Syntax
void Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation (
NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,
const uint8* PncBitVectorPtr,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x29
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non-reentrant for the same NetworkHandle, reentrant otherwise
NetworkHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
PncBitVectorPtr
Pointer to the PNC bit vector which was considered for
transmission
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The PNC bit vector has been transmitted
E_NOT_OK: The transmission of the PNC bit vector failed
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Function called by <Bus>Nms to confirm the state of the transmission for the given PNC bit
vector on the given NM-Channel.
Available via
Nm.h
⌋
